name: Tiger
traits: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
Medium Beast with +2 Strength, +1 Dexterity, 40-ft. walk, and 60-ft. darkvision. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell. Speaks, reads and writes Common.

Bite and Claw. An unarmed hit has a 1d8 base die and deals piercing or slashing. Strength or Dexterity can govern the attack and damage rolls. Both strikes count as finesse weapons for effects such as Sneak Attack.

Pounce. Move at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward a target and hit that same turn with an unarmed strike. The tiger can then spend its bonus action to attempt a shove to knock that creature prone.
No Hands. Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or use tools, foci, or other items requiring manipulation.
Saber-Toothed Tiger shares this player block by the p. 262 cross-reference.

name: Weasel
traits: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
Tiny Beast with +2 Dexterity, +1 Wisdom, and a 30-ft. walk. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell. Speaks, reads and writes Common.
Bite. An unarmed hit uses a 1d4 piercing die. Choose Strength or Dexterity for both rolls. The bite counts as a finesse weapon for any effect requiring one.

No Hands. Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or manipulate items such as tools and foci. Under the supplement’s Tiny rules, fitted armor weighs a quarter of normal, and lifting and carrying capacity is one quarter of a Medium creature with the same Strength. The racial bite keeps its printed die.

name: Winter Wolf
traits: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
Medium Monstrosity with +1 Strength, +1 Constitution, and 40-ft. walk. Speaks, reads and writes Common, Giant, and Winter Wolf.

The bite is a 1d8 piercing unarmed strike. Natural armor gives unarmored AC 12 + Dexterity modifier. Advantage on smell- or hearing-based Wisdom (Perception) and Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in snow.

Cold Breath. Action. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a Dexterity save against 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier. On a failure take 2d6 cold damage, halved on success. Damage is 3d6 at level 6, 4d6 at 11, and 5d6 at 16. Once per short or long rest.
Trip. After an unarmed hit, spend a bonus action to attempt a shove to knock the target prone.
No Hands. Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or use objects requiring manipulation.

name: Wolf
traits: Tyler Kamstra’s DMs Guild player conversion. This profile uses the v2 trait block for 2014 fifth edition.
Medium Beast with +1 Dexterity and 40-ft. walk. Unarmored natural AC is 11 + Dexterity modifier. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks using hearing or smell. Speaks, reads and writes Common.
Pack Tactics. As a bonus action, gain advantage on the next attack roll that turn against a creature with a non-incapacitated ally of the wolf within 5 ft. of it.
Trip. After hitting with an unarmed strike, spend a bonus action to attempt a shove to knock the target prone. Trip and Pack Tactics each use the bonus action.
Dire Wolf uses this same player block by the p. 229 cross-reference.

Natural armor gives unarmored AC 12 + Dexterity modifier. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell.
Trip. After an unarmed hit, spend a bonus action to attempt a shove to knock the target prone.
